title: FarmLand Mortgage Terms Schedule: Assumption, Payoff Quotes and Annual Financial Statements (Farm Real Estate Loans)
content:
Four further terms of Farm Real Estate Loans are set per product:

- **Assumption allowed** — whether a qualified buyer may assume the loan with credit approval (yes or no).
- **Assumption fee** — as a percentage of the principal balance assumed; 0 where assumption is not allowed.
- **Annual financial statements threshold** — the principal balance at or above which annual balance sheet and income statements are required, in USD.
- **Payoff quote validity** — the calendar days a payoff quote remains good, the quote date being day 0.

| Product | Assumption allowed | Assumption fee (% of principal assumed) | Annual statements required at or above (USD principal) | Payoff quote good for (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage | yes | 1.0 | 1000000 | 15 |
| FarmLand 3-Year Adjustable Mortgage | yes | 1.0 | 1000000 | 15 |
| FarmLand 5-Year Adjustable Mortgage | yes | 1.0 | 1000000 | 15 |
| FarmLand 10-Year Adjustable Mortgage | no | 0 | 1000000 | 15 |
| FarmLand 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | no | 0 | 750000 | 15 |
| FarmLand 25-Year Fixed Mortgage | no | 0 | 750000 | 15 |

## Points of reading

- Only the FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage and the 3-Year and 5-Year Adjustable Mortgages may be assumed; on the 10-Year Adjustable, 15-Year Fixed and 25-Year Fixed Mortgages the assumption fee is 0 because assumption is not allowed.
- **Statements threshold boundary.** The threshold is "at or above": a principal balance of exactly USD 1000000 on the Variable-Rate product requires annual balance sheet and income statements, and USD 999999.99 does not; on the 15-Year and 25-Year Fixed Mortgages the same holds at USD 750000.
- **Quote validity (hypothetical dates).** With the quote date as day 0, a quote dated on the first of a month is good through the sixteenth of that month (day 15) and is no longer good on the seventeenth.
